<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#110053" flood-opacity=".16"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#110053"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="331" y1="16" x2="337" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="13" x2="337" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="10" x2="337" y2="10" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="12" x2="351" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="362" y="9" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="11" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="380" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="74" fill="#110053"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,67 22,74 30,81" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="74" x2="41" y2="74" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="56" y="71" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Elegir asientos</text>
  <text x="56" y="89" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Asignación de pasajeros</text>
  <circle cx="361" cy="67" r="16" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <circle cx="361" cy="62" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="361" cy="72" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Main loading content -->
  <text x="195" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Preparando tu mapa de asientos</text>
  <text x="195" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Estamos cargando los asientos disponibles</text>

  <!-- Travel illustration panel -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="35" y="210" width="320" height="330" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="195" cy="367" r="112" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="367" r="87" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".65"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="292" r="8" fill="#EA104C" opacity=".8"/>
  <circle cx="270" cy="335" r="5" fill="#9747FF" opacity=".7"/>
  <circle cx="119" cy="410" r="6" fill="#0BAEAF" opacity=".75"/>

  <!-- Window / aircraft illustration -->
  <rect x="105" y="270" width="180" height="151" rx="30" fill="#110053"/>
  <rect x="117" y="282" width="156" height="127" rx="22" fill="#4658E0"/>
  <circle cx="238" cy="310" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
  <polygon points="128,390 168,345 190,367 221,329 266,390" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <polygon points="128,390 160,365 183,390" fill="#9747FF"/>
  <line x1="128" y1="390" x2="266" y2="390" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" opacity=".7"/>

  <!-- aircraft -->
  <path d="M137 355 L177 345 L223 349 L258 359 L223 366 L179 362 L145 371 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M178 350 L191 318 L201 318 L202 351 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M190 361 L173 391 L183 392 L204 365 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M222 353 L245 334 L252 338 L236 358 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M137 355 L121 344 L116 350 L132 362 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- clouds -->
  <path d="M80 322 C80 313 88 307 97 309 C100 300 109 295 119 299 C125 301 129 307 129 314 L129 322 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".75"/>
  <path d="M257 406 C257 398 264 393 272 395 C276 387 286 384 293 389 C298 392 300 397 300 403 L300 406 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".75"/>

  <!-- decorative route line -->
  <polyline points="88,455 127,438 164,452 202,433 239,446 298,425" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="455" r="4" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <circle cx="298" cy="425" r="4" fill="#EA104C"/>

  <!-- Progress information -->
  <text x="195" y="490" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Un momento, por favor</text>
  <text x="195" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Esto puede tardar unos segundos</text>

  <!-- Bottom loading tray -->
  <rect x="0" y="610" width="390" height="234" fill="#110053"/>
  <rect x="0" y="610" width="390" height="5" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <text x="24" y="649" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Cargando selección de asientos</text>
  <text x="24" y="672" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">Vuelo LA 532 · Santiago — Lima</text>

  <!-- spinner -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="723" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" opacity=".25"/>
  <polyline points="195,699 204,701 211,707" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="723" r="7" fill="#EA104C"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <line x1="0" y1="775" x2="390" y2="775" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity=".22"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="33,795 43,787 53,795 53,806 33,806" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="30,795 43,784 56,795" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="43" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Inicio</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="121" cy="795" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="802" x2="134" y2="809" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="121" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Buscar</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="178" y="787" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="792" x2="195" y2="792" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="797" x2="193" y2="797" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="189" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Mis viajes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="278" cy="793" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="278" cy="793" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="278" y1="783" x2="278" y2="780" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="278" y1="806" x2="278" y2="809" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="278" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Ayuda</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="791" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="803" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="350" y="826" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
</svg>
